notes:
- 2026-02-18 call w/ Head of Search (Anika Rao) + Platform PM (Darren). Intro + scope: replace existing Elastic-based semantic layer with ingest->embeddings->ANN->rerank pipeline.
- Use-case: support KB for 3 product lines, goal to reduce time-to-resolution and escalate less. Primary traffic spikes during morning US hours.
- Index size estimate: initial 450k CSV/docs (docs vary 1-25KB); expected growth 20% qtr.
- Performance targets: p50 end-to-end (ANN fetch + rerank) <= 60ms, p95 <= 220ms at steady 500 QPS; soft target 1k QPS burst.
- Cost sensitivity: target net cost per query (embedding + rerank) < $0.004 at 500 QPS scale; finance pushed back on anything > $0.01/q.
- Model preferences: prefer open/quantized embeddings for indexing (consistent vectors); reranker can be smaller LLM (instruction-tuned), want automated fallback to cheaper model for bulk reranking.
- Security: SSO via Okta required, audit logs mandatory, KMS for keys, retention controls for support transcripts (30-90 days configurable).
- Deployment choice: leaning hosted_api for speed of launch; legal asked about Private for EU residency but product team prefers hosted first.
- Evaluation plan agreed: Redwood to run hosted POC with 450k doc index + synthetic traffic generator to 500 QPS; Redwood Optimize to recommend batching/quantization profile pre-POC.
- Action items from meeting: 1) SE (Liam) to deliver POC config + estimated cost model by 2026-02-22; 2) Security to provide SOC2 artifact & KMS architecture doc; 3) SalientBridge to share sample dataset & query distribution by 2026-02-24.
- 2026-02-25: follow-up call — demo of reranking tradeoffs (dense-only vs dense+rerank) + cost modelling. Anika: "If we can get p95 under 200ms and cost < $0.005/q we can justify replacing existing infra."
- 2026-02-28: Redwood sent POC config + traffic script (drive links above) and initial cost estimate. SalientBridge legal opened RWD-3421 for SOC2 evidence.
- 2026-03-01: internal pilot scheduled. POC kickoff scheduled 2026-03-08.
- Notes style: shorthand; expect more granular metrics after POC run.
